name: deepseek-harness
description: Attach Codex to an existing authorized DeepSeek Harness Desktop session, with approvals in the GUI.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate into your existing Desktop Host.
interface.longDescription: Connect to an existing user-authorized Desktop Host. Keep its configured models and human approvals in Desktop GUI. Persist session identifiers and independently review results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check Desktop attach readiness. Connect only with a connection file I explicitly approve, then delegate in the scoped workspace. Show dsh://open and sessionId, keep approvals in Desktop, and review the actual result.
